hypothesis: 4 fps (250ms) cannot resolve ball-through-net (~200ms); 8 fps recovers outcome discrimination
findings: Doubling fps changed zero scored labels at every stage.
fps does improve confidence and coverage: W5 two_point_miss 0.49->0.85, moved from review queue to auto-confirmed, and a second event (offensive_rebound) was recovered.
W4 free_throw_made persists at 0.90 across two frame rates with a specific claim (ball through basket at 08.7s); single-pass control and reference both say miss.
W1 now contradicted by four independent runs across two pipeline designs and two frame rates.

next_action.step: human re-adjudication of W1 and W4 reference labels
next_action.rationale: two of four labels in this subset are contradicted by every run ever made against them; no further tuning is decidable until resolved
